findings.description: [MINOR] Band 2 REPO OUTPUT Total row (04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png, 06-activity-map-dark-mobile.png, 07-activity-map-light-mobile.png): 'Other public (25)' and 'Private repos' now cleanly align into the right-aligned commits and PRs columns, and the divider rule above Total resolves the separation issue from v12. However, the Total row itself ('Total — 5.8k commits · 1.9k PRs · 38 active repos') reverts to a single left-packed inline string, leaving the right ~65% of the row empty directly beneath the tabular count columns on desktop. Suggested direction: place 'Total · 38 active repos' on the left and right-align bold '5.8k commits' and '1.9k PRs' directly under the commits and PRs columns so the eye can verify vertical totals in one scan.

[MINOR] Band 3 header divider consistency (08-stack-dark-desktop.png, 09-stack-light-desktop.png, 10-stack-dark-mobile.png, 11-stack-light-mobile.png): Band 2 separates its band title ('GITHUB ACTIVITY') from its first subsection ('REPO OUTPUT') with a full-width hairline divider, whereas Band 3 places 'TECHNOLOGY STACK' directly above 'DESIGN & MOTION' / 'LANGUAGES' with no rule. When stacked vertically in the README, this creates a subtle structural mismatch between peer bands. Suggested direction: add a matching subtle hairline divider below 'TECHNOLOGY STACK' at the same spacing as Band 2's 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' header.

[MINOR] Band 1 desktop Discord cluster right-margin alignment (00-identity-dark-desktop.png, 01-identity-light-desktop.png): Much improved from v11/v12, with zero icon stranding and a cohesive status unit, but 'last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' still stops ~14-18px shy of the right margin established by the horizontal dividers and TOP LANGUAGES bar (and by Band 2's flush-right headers directly below). Suggested direction: anchor the right end of the text run flush to the right content margin (text-anchor='end') and compute only the Clyde glyph's x from measured/calibrated run width, or nudge the cluster's start x right by ~15px so it locks to the same right grid edge as Band 2.

[MINOR] Band 2 RECENT PUBLIC EVENTS middot spacing drift (04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png, 06-activity-map-dark-mobile.png, 07-activity-map-light-mobile.png): On rows 'restro-pv · 2 pushes · 02:46' and 'tastile/tastile-root · pushed · 00:51', the gap between the repo name and the first middot is visibly wider (~12-14px) than on adjacent rows like 'my-web-2026 · pushed' or 'herdr-t3 · created' (~7-8px), indicating separate text element placement using approximate character widths. Suggested direction: render each event row as a single <text> element with styled <tspan> runs (repo name in primary monospace, action and timestamp in muted sans/mono) so spacing is exact across every row.

[MINOR] Band 2 desktop REPO OUTPUT row tracking in dark mode (04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png): The faint horizontal row hairlines added in v13 help slightly in light mode, but in dark mode they are nearly imperceptible, leaving a ~530-600px blank horizontal span between short bars ('atcoder-kit') or aggregate labels ('Other public (25)', 'Private repos') and their right-aligned counts. Suggested direction: slightly raise the row-divider opacity in dark mode (e.g., from ~3% to ~7-9% white) and include a subtle divider between 'Other public (25)' and 'Private repos' (or subtly tighten the max bar span while keeping tabular counts anchored right) to improve horizontal row tracking without adding visual noise.

[INFO] Timestamp punctuation hierarchy in Band 1 and Band 2 headers (00-07): Strings like 'Offline · last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' and 'last 30 days · observed Nov 24 · 09:00 JST' use the same middle-dot separator both between distinct clauses and between the date and time of a single timestamp. Using 'Nov 24, 22:46 JST' (or a space without a middot) would preserve cleaner semantic grouping. Also, in Band 1's '206 DAY STREAK · BEST 206D', when current equals best, 'PERSONAL BEST' or 'ALL-TIME BEST' reads less robotically than repeating '206D'.

verdict.summary: APPROVE (ready to ship; optional minor polish noted). All v12 findings—including the MAJOR light-mode React SVG black-fill defect—and all prior v9-v11 major issues are resolved. Across the 8 evaluation criteria: (1) First-glance comprehension is immediate: avatar, handle, concise discipline tagline, active streak/contributions, top languages, active repos, and creative+engineering stack read in a clear, natural order. (2) Information hierarchy is disciplined and editorial—unboxed bands with hairlines avoid the generic boxed-dashboard trap, hero KPIs cleanly outweigh secondary stats, aggregate repo buckets step back visually, and 40px primary craft icons clearly outrank 28px infra/dev tools. (3) Visuals are honest and decodable without a legend manual—bare proportional bars without misleading progress tracks, explicit 'last synced'/'observed' timestamps, and accurate aggregate math across desktop/mobile. (4) GitHub-native language (language bar, Octicon-style glyphs, monospace repo names, tabular commit/PR columns, skill-icons) fits naturally inside a README. (5) Discord presence reads unmistakably via the avatar's ringed offline indicator paired with the cohesive Clyde status line, with transparent sync time. (6) Typography and whitespace feel designed rather than assembled across both dark and light themes, with crisp React/brand icon rendering. (7) Mobile at 400px is compact, legible, and intentionally composed—especially Band 3, where all four icon lanes align cleanly on both margins. (8) Overall: this is personal-profile quality I would gladly publish. Top 3 ranked polish changes if doing one final micro-pass: 1) Align Band 2's Total row counts ('5.8k commits', '1.9k PRs') under the tabular right columns instead of left-packing them into prose; 2) Add a matching hairline rule under Band 3's 'TECHNOLOGY STACK' title to unify cross-band structure with Band 2; 3) Flush-align Band 1 desktop's Discord status run to the true right margin and use <tspan> in Band 2 event rows to eliminate middot spacing drift.
